description.narrative: 1. The project will construct two units of 450 MW energy efficient combined cycle gas turbines at the Talimarjan Thermal Power Plant located in Kashkadarya region, contributing to energy saving, greenhouse gas emission reduction, and reliable power supply in Uzbekistan. The project will build on the experience gained through Talimarjan Power Project (phase 1 project) by further improving the corporate governance and promoting commercialization of the energy sector.
